checks.name: logic_errors_explicitly_corrected
checks.value: R33 remaining cluster visibility does not prove that risers are too low or that terrace amplitude should increase. It also does not justify unrestricted dilation into new terrain. Two earlier R34 formulations further confused geometric sophistication with useful computation by repeatedly recomputing off-axis or duplicated permission fields. Final R34 tests the smallest causal change: strengthen only already-positive inherited support and leave all zero-support boundaries and elevation quantization unchanged.
checks.limit: reject low-riser, outward-dilation and over-complexity shortcuts

checks.name: failed_attempts_are_retained
checks.value: the first R34 implementation used local R30 gradient tangents plus six off-axis permission probes per terrace query; a second formulation still recomputed duplicated permission fields. Both kept numeric generation running for minutes rather than the normal round budget. They remain in Git history but were rejected instead of treating compute cost as irrelevant.
checks.limit: retain computationally impractical attempts in history

checks.name: real_world_constraint_is_explicit

This positive-mask remap is synthetic QA morphology, not Yunnan survey or engineering truth.

checks.name: xiaoma_truth_boundary_retained
checks.value: the Xiaoma/TLO intake still records field location/boundary, field microtopography, bund section, channel section and water-control elevation as unknown. Geometric continuity is not sufficient evidence for ownership, hydraulic connectivity, head, water depth or discharge. R34 creates none of those states.

checks.name: mrrolord_ordering_only
checks.value: the saved frame audit is used for ordering only: drainage hierarchy -> accumulated terrain influence -> terrain-conforming contour land use. R34 keeps the inherited hydrology-first exclusions and changes only deterministic world-space terrace support strength; it does not copy Blender dimensions, Voronoi cells, shader displacement or adaptive subdivision as agricultural truth.

checks.name: user_reference_reopened_without_metric_inference
checks.value: image(173).png was reopened this round. R34 uses only visible morphology: long contour-following terrace ribbons read as coherent families with local joins and nesting while narrow interruptions remain. No metric terrace width, merge distance, riser height, channel size or water depth is inferred.
